transforms.code:
# Traer la lista de selectionRun (ya es una lista de dicts)
	selectionRun = value
	tableInterval = self.view.params.dsTableScaleInterval #this.props.params.dsTableScalesInterval
	
	# Obtener todos los WorkorderID de esa lista
	workorderIDs = [item["WorkorderID"] for item in selectionRun]
	#return workorderIDs
	# Convertir el dataset entrante a PyDataset
	pyds = system.dataset.toPyDataSet(tableInterval)
	#return pyds
	# Crear lista para las filas filtradas
	filteredRows = []
	
	for row in pyds:
	    if row["WorkorderID"] in workorderIDs:
	        filteredRows.append([
	            row["WorkOrderID"],
	            row["Performance"] if row["Performance"] is None else row["Performance"] *100
	        ])
	
	# Encabezados originales
	headers = ["WorkOrderID", "Performance"]
	
	# Retornar dataset filtrado
	return system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, filteredRows)

	    "visible": True,
	    "editable": False,

	    "justify": "center",

	    "resizable": True,

	        "number": {"condition": "", "value": ""},
	        "boolean": {"condition": ""},

	    },
	    "viewPath": "",
	    "viewParams": {},

	    "number": "value",
	    "progressBar": {
	        "max": 100,

	        "bar": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}},
	        "track": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}},
	        "value": {
	            "enabled": True,
	            "format": "0,0.##",
	            "justify": "center",
	            "style": {"classes": ""}
	        }
	    },
	    "toggleSwitch": {"color": {"selected": "", "unselected": ""}},
	    "nullFormat": {
	        "includeNullStrings": False,
	        "strict": True,
	        "nullFormatValue": ""
	    },
	    "numberFormat": "0,0.##",
	    "dateFormat": "MM/DD/YYYY",
	    "width": 200,
	    "strictWidth": True,
	    "style": {"classes": ""},
	    "header": {
	        "title": "",
	        "justify": "center",
	        "align": "center",
	        "style": {"classes": ""}
	    },
	    "footer": {
	        "title": "",
	        "justify": "center",
	        "align": "center",
	        "style": {"classes": ""}
	    }
	}
	
	config_list = []
	
	for col in columns:
	    cfg = copy.deepcopy(base_config)  # 👈 copia profunda
	    cfg["field"] = col
	
	    if col == "Description":
	        cfg["width"] = 500
	        cfg["strictWidth"] = True
	        cfg["header"]["title"] = "Descripcion"
	        cfg["header"]["justify"] = "center"
	        cfg["justify"] = "auto"
	    else:
	        # Si termina en número, quitamos todos los dígitos
	        if re.search(r"\d+$", col):
	            clean_title = re.sub(r"\d+$", "", col).strip()
	        else:
	            clean_title = col
	        cfg["header"]["title"] = clean_title
	
	    config_list.append(cfg)
	
	return config_list
